Final Reflection Paper

Please follow the Academic Honesty Policy and the Student Code of Conduct (Part 1: Academic Integrity). The Academic Integrity Basics guide may also be helpful.

Use of AI tools is generally permitted for take-home assignments, provided that you clearly acknowledge their use in your submission. Failure to declare AI use may be considered plagiarism, which is a serious academic offence. There is no penalty for declaring AI use; your work will be assessed solely on its quality. We encourage responsible and transparent use of AI.

For the school's position on the use of AI in coursework, please read the Guidelines for AI in Teaching and Learning (Parts 3 and 4), which set out recommended practices and expectations.

Sample AI Tool Declaration
I used [AI tool name, e.g., GPT-4.1] to [describe specific uses: e.g., generate ideas, format paragraphs, improve expression, analyse effectiveness, create images and illustrations, produce drafts, refine, and/or finalise my assignment]. I am responsible for the content and quality of the submitted work.

Due10 Nov by 23:59 Points20 Submittingan external tool Available30 Jun at 0:00 - 17 Nov at 23:59

This assignment should be attempted only after at least 70% of the field visits have been completed.

Objective

This assignment aims to give students a platform to:

  • Reflect on their field visits and consider how studying a city up close has changed the way they read public spaces
  • Consider the wider issues of housing, transport, policy and access that they encounter in the field and how these issues may be addressed

--------------------------

The City Portfolio consists of two parts:

  1. Field Visit Presentation
  2. Final Reflection Paper

Final Reflection Paper (20%)

Write a 1000 - 1200 word reflection to the following questions. You may include references where appropriate.

  1. Based on your own field visits as well as those of your classmates (as shared in Seminar 3), what is one public issue faced by the neighbourhood you studied? Illustrate this with relevant examples.
  2. How do you think society can collectively address this issue? Consider the government, community and individuals in your discussion.

You may integrate theory and concepts from the various e-lectures and tutorials in your course.

Declaration on use of Generative AI tools

In the 'Assignment Comments' section of your video submission, students must declare usage of generative AI tools using this statement:

"Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, etc) have been used to generate the output for this submission."

And give a brief description (max. 100 words) of how you have used them.

Please note: Your submission is graded solely based on quality of your work. No marks are deducted for any declaration that generative AI tools have been used. However, failure to declare constitutes plagiarism, a serious academic offence that may lead to 'F' grade for the assignment.
